title: Yellow Malaysian Mitsuba Noodles
description: A fresh and festive Malaysian dish featuring mitsuba, served on a talavera plate. This kosher-friendly recipe uses a bain-marie to cook the noodles to perfection.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot.
Add the rice noodles and cook for 3 minutes.
Prepare a bain-marie by filling a large bowl with hot water.
Place a talavera plate over the bowl to warm it.
Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped mitsuba and cook until wilted.
Add the turmeric and salt and stir to combine.
Drain the noodles and add them to the pan.
Toss the noodles with the mitsuba mixture and serve on the warmed talavera plate.
